```yaml
name: Cleanup Neon Preview Branch

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
      NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
      PR_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Delete Neon preview branch
        run: |
          ENCODED_BRANCH=$(printf '%s' "$PR_BRANCH" | jq -sRr @uri)
          echo "Deleting Neon branch: $PR_BRANCH"
          curl --fail -X DELETE "https://api.neon.tech/v1/projects/${NEON_PROJECT_ID}/branches/${ENCODED_BRANCH}" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEON_API_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json"
        shell: bash
```
